name: php-station
description: PHP Station: a free, zero-dependency local PHP development environment for Windows. Run many PHP / Laravel projects side by side, each with its own PHP version, Composer and MariaDB server. A modern XAMPP / Laragon alternative with a setup wizard, phpMyAdmin, crash-safe databases, automatic backups and one-click repair.
author: Sami Hussain (x8code - https://x8code.com)
